newsitem.title: BRAZIL: No date set for Cemig tender details - BNDES.
newsitem.headline: No date set for Cemig tender details - BNDES.

text.p: Brazil's National Development Bank (BNDES) said it has no schedule for the publication of tender documents to sell off debentures convertible into Minas Gerais state power firm Cemig common shares.
"There is no schedule for the publication of Cemig's tender documents," said BNDES president Luiz Carlos Mendonca de Barros, adding BNDES is still working on the details.
Mendonca de Barros said the debentures, which will be convertible to a 32.9 percent voting stake in Cemig, will be sold for a minimum price of $1.1 billion. He recognized the price is high.
He also said BNDES is studying the creation of a credit line to finance the purchase of the debentures.
Cemig's tender documents had been expected last week.
